description.value: Sunflower Cafe is a seasonal farm-to-table restaurant in Maple Ridge where the chef and gardener collaborate to cultivate over 200 varieties of certified organic produce using no-till, regenerative methods. The cafe is exclusively outdoors — gazebo and open-air seating place diners directly inside the working farm — making it a genuinely immersive experience. A five-course tasting menu and à la carte selections showcase hyper-seasonal ingredients alongside a curated list of natural BC wines.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and confirms a real, operating seasonal restaurant on a working organic farm in Maple Ridge, BC, with contact details (phone, address, email) matching OSM exactly. No bike infrastructure, water refill, or Wi-Fi is mentioned on the website or in OSM tags; OSM tags toilets=yes and toilets:access=customers, which is unrebutted by the website and consistent with a sit-down dinner establishment. The brunch navigation items on the website contain no menu content, consistent with OSM's breakfast=no and lunch=no, indicating dinner-only service from 4:30 pm onward.
concerns: OSM addr:street is '272 Street'; website uses '272nd Street' — minor ordinal formatting difference, same physical location.

Website has a 'Brunch' navigation section but all brunch subpages contain no menu content, consistent with OSM breakfast=no and lunch=no; the cafe appears to be dinner-only despite the navigation label.
Operation is seasonal (May 1–September 28 per FAQ); outside this window the business is closed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating seasonal restaurant with a confirmed website, matching contact details, and active menu — a notable farm-to-table dinner destination for touring cyclists passing through Maple Ridge.

Washrooms.detail: Not contradicted by website. Consistent with a sit-down licensed dinner restaurant
